events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): The more you use Copilot in Office the better it gets
events.titleJa: Office で Copilot を使えば使うほど、より良くなります
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): The more you use Copilot in Office the better it gets
events.summary: Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Workspaces across Copilot App and OneNote will use memory to learn your work patterns and personalize responses. With memory, Copilot can offer more relevant suggestions, hold the pen in a way that represents you, and adapt to your preferences over time
events.summaryJa: Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Copilot アプリおよび OneNote のワークスペースで、Copilot がメモリを使ってユーザーの作業パターンを学習し、応答をパーソナライズします。さらに、より関連性の高い提案を行い、ユーザーらしい文体で文章を作成し、使い続けるほど好みに適応します。
events.summaryEn: Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Workspaces across Copilot App and OneNote will use memory to learn your work patterns and personalize responses. With memory, Copilot can offer more relevant suggestions, hold the pen in a way that represents you, and adapt to your preferences over time
